div.head: Af 41
div.ab: XXXVII. Se mon se þe boclond hæbbe, ⁊ him (þonne) his yldran læfdon, þonne setton we, ðæt he hit ne mot syllan of his mægburge, gif ðær bið gewrit oððe gewitnes, ðæt hit ðara monna forbod wære ðe hit on fruman gestrindon ⁊ ðara ðe hit him sealdon, ðæt he swa ne mote; ⁊ ðæt þonne on cyninges ge on biscopes gewitnesse gerecce beforan his magum.

XXXVII. Se mon se ðe bócland hæbbe, ⁊ him his mægas lǽfden, þonne setton we, þæt he hit ne moste sellan of his mægburge, gif þær bið gewrit oððe gewitnes, ðæt hit ðara manna forbod wære þe hit on fruman gestrindon ⁊ þara þe hit him sealdon, þæt he swa ne mote; ⁊ þæt þonne on cyninges ⁊ on biscopes gewitnesse gerecce beforan his mægum.

De eo qui terram testamentalem (hereditariam) habet, quam ei parentes sui dimiserunt, ponimus, ne illam extra cognationem suam mittere possit, si scriptum intersit testamenti et testes, quod eorum prohibitio fuerit qui hanc inprimis adquisierunt et ipsorum qui dederunt ei, ne hoc possit; et hoc in regis et episcopi testimonio recitetur coram parentela sua.

{XXXVII} Se mon se ðe bocland hæbbe, ⁊ him his mægas læfden, þonne setton we, þæt he hit ne moste sellan of his mægburge, gif þær bið gewrit oððe gewitnes, ðæt hit ðara manna forbod wære þe hit on fruman gestríndon ⁊ þara þe hit him sealdon, þæt he swa ne mote; ⁊ ðæt þonne on cyninges ⁊ on biscopes gewitnesse gerecce beforan his mægum.

[In the case of] the man who has bookland which his kin left to him: we thus determine that he may not sell it out of his kindred if there is writing or testimony that it was forbidden by those who first acquired it or by those who gave it to him, that he thus might not [remove it from the family possession]. And let him [who is contesting the sale] declare this in the presence of his kin with the knowledge of the king and of the bishop.

We have further established, that a man who holds land by title-deed, which his kinsmen have left him, shall not be allowed to give it out to his kindred, if there is documentary or [other] evidence that the power to do so is forbidden him by the men who first acquired it, or by those who gave it to him. [And he who contests such an alienation] shall make a declaration to this effect in the presence of his kindred, with the king and bishop as witnesses.

Jemand, der Urkunden-Grundbesitz hat, welchen ihm seine Verwandten hinterliessen: [über ihn] setzten wir nun fest, dass er ihn nicht aus seiner Sippe veräussern darf, wenn Urkunde oder Zeugniss vorhanden ist, dass dies ein Verbot sei [von Seiten] jener Personen, die ihn zu Anfang erwarben, und jener, die ihn ihm gaben, dass er so nicht [veräussern] dürfe; und dies erweise [wer die Veräusserung anficht] mit des Königs und des Bischofs Zeugniss vor seinen Verwandten.

Someone who holds land by charter, which his kinsmen left him: [concerning him] we have now determined that he may not alienate it from his kindred, if there is a document or witness that this was a prohibition [on the part] of those persons who acquired it in the beginning and of those who gave it to him, that he might not [alienate it] so; and let [whoever challenges the alienation] prove this with the witness of the king and of the bishop before his kinsmen.
